outcome: One-shot migrate every current unfinished, non-withdrawn Outer Blackboard work item into the delivered Blackboard V2 control plane, verify semantic parity, atomically cut authority over to V2, and remove the legacy unfinished-work control representation.
currentProblem: After Blackboard V2 exists, current unfinished work still lives in the legacy graph/artifact lifecycle. Maintaining compatibility or dual-write would preserve the split-brain problem. DONE work is already consolidated into Living Docs and backed up, so it does not need migration; withdrawn duplicate work has no delivery value. The migration should therefore normalize only live unfinished work once, prove parity, cut authority, and retire legacy control state.
constraints: BB-155 must be DELIVERED before migration execution begins.
Migrate only tasks that are unfinished and not explicitly withdrawn at the exact cutover snapshot. DONE tasks are not migrated; their delivered truth is Living Docs.
No dual-write and no long-lived legacy reader after cutover. V2 becomes the sole write/read authority for migrated current work.

Preserve work ids, semantic objective/current plan, direct dependencies, components, lane/phase meaning, and any current readiness/candidate/evaluation authority that is still valid at the cutover snapshot.
Do not invent historical generations. Each migrated Work starts at V2 generation 1 (or one deterministic initial generation) with legacy source SHA recorded as migration provenance.
Existing raw evidence/receipt files may remain as immutable referenced blobs when still required by an unfinished Work; physical storage cleanup is not required for cutover.
Migration must fail before authority switch if any unfinished Work cannot be transformed or if parity/next-action verification differs.
successCriteria: An exact cutover manifest enumerates every unfinished non-withdrawn legacy work item and excludes every DONE and withdrawn item.
Every manifest entry becomes exactly one V2 Work with preserved id, objective/plan semantics, dependencies/components and phase-relevant authority bindings.
Legacy and V2 derivations agree for dependency readiness/blockers and the legal immediate next action for every migrated work item before cutover.
The authority switch is atomic/fail-closed: either all manifest work is available from V2 and legacy current-work authority is retired, or no cutover is published.

After cutover, fresh sessions create/show/next/build context exclusively through V2; no current unfinished work requires work-graph registration, currentContextRef, process docs or jev.md to infer lifecycle.
Legacy DONE work is absent from V2 migration state and remains represented only by delivered Living Docs/backup; withdrawn duplicates remain absent.
